derivation: first 10 bytes of the 32-byte RFC 7638 SHA-256 thumbprint, big-endian, most significant bit first, 5 bits per character
normalisation: trim; remove spaces and '-'; upper-case; O to 0, I to 1, L to 1; 16 characters -> compare with the code; otherwise compare the trimmed raw input with the full 43-character thumbprint

vectors.title: Key with a 0 and a 1 in its code (every look-alike substitution has a positive case)
The enrollment key of EP-01 (its thumbprint is the one EP-01 carries, and contains both '-' and '_')
Key whose code starts with a 1
Key with a 1 in its code and a thumbprint containing '_'
